description: Spends 1 credit per complete UK record against a live machine quote from quote_order, and queues the order. It needs the quote_id and an idempotency_key to reuse on any retry, so a retry never charges twice; a flag set by a model is never consent. Where the host supports elicitation the user confirms the spend in a form or on mydatahub.emailmovers.com; otherwise an agent key must cover it within its per-order cap and monthly budget. If neither applies nothing is charged: the result is a confirmation-required error with an approval_url to give the user, so keep the quote_id; a short balance returns a top_up_url. Call get_order until the status is ready, then fetch_order_records. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.

confirmation_token.description: The token the approval page on mydatahub.emailmovers.com returns once the signed-in person approves. It is bound to that person (their sub), this spend (the machine quote_id, or the enrichment or push) and an expiry no later than the quote's, and it is redeemable once.

delivery.description: api (fetch records), csv (signed download) and google_sheets. Default api.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, such as a V4 UUID. Reuse it when retrying the same order so it is never charged twice; a different order needs a new key.

quote_id.description: A live machine quote from quote_order. Without one nothing is charged.

name: create_order

BuyerKit.description: Four signed documents that help the buyer use the list lawfully.

ConfirmedBy.description: Who approved the spend and from which client, recorded in the audit trail and on invoices.

client_id.description: The OAuth client, such as a Client ID Metadata Document URL.

method.description: elicitation_form (the MCP form), approval_url (the approval page's confirmation_token), agent_key (a pre-authorised agent key within its limits) or app (a person ordering in the app itself, a first-party session; third-party OAuth clients never count).

mtls_certificate_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the client certificate when one was presented (ChatGPT's mTLS).

web_bot_auth_signature_agent.description: The Signature-Agent of a verified Web Bot Auth signature, when present.

Licence.description: Licence terms as data, on every quote, order, records page and receipt. Records stay usable, pushable and re-downloadable free until reuse_until.

permitted_channels.description: email, telephone and post on standard terms.

reuse_until.description: Order date plus 12 months; null for outright.

terms_url.description: Where that version of the Data Licence and Sharing Agreement is published.

terms_version.description: The version of the Data Licence and Sharing Agreement the licence is under, such as 1.0.

type.description: multi_use_12m (12 month multi-use, every plan) or outright (1.8 credits a record, proposed).

ValidationReportLinks.description: The per-order validation report: dataset version, status distribution, verification age, expected bounce band, TPS screen date, provider locations and the guarantee window.

outputSchema.description: The purchase and its delivery: status, records, charges, the licence, links to records, download, the validation report and the signed compliance receipt.

cost_gbp.description: The value of the credits charged, in GBP, plus VAT (VAT is not included in this figure; it is paid when credits are bought). Credits bought by card count at what their purchase cost, and card-bought credits are used oldest first; free trial credits count at 0; any other credits at your plan's rate (a new customer's rate on the free plan).

count_id.description: The count the machine quote was priced from.

credits_charged.description: Credits, to one decimal place: whole at 1 credit a record, fractional only where a rule is (0.1 company-only, 1.8 outright, both proposed).

credits_remaining.description: The balance right after this order was charged.

dataset_version.description: The immutable weekly build a count is bound to, such as 2026-W39. The last 52 stay queryable.

download_url.description: 302 to a single-use signed URL that lives 5 minutes.

id.description: Format: an order id: ord_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as ord_01JB4N9S3W2X6Y7Z8A1B2C3D4E.

licence_expires_at.description: When the licence ends; null for outright ownership.

quote_id.description: The machine quote the order settled.

receipt_url.description: A path on https://mydatahub.emailmovers.com starting /v1/. Resolve it against the origin (RFC 3986), not by appending it to the server URL.

records_url.description: A path on https://mydatahub.emailmovers.com starting /v1/. Resolve it against the origin (RFC 3986), not by appending it to the server URL.

status.description: queued, building, verifying, ready; failed if processing failed; cancelled (only while queued).

test.description: A test mode order (a test key, or anyone in a demo organisation): no credits were charged, the records are invented and no licence is granted. Absent on a live order.

validation_report.description: Present once the order is ready.

verification.description: The real-time check at delivery, such as 4,102 checked, 4,071 passed.
